source: 2026-11-12 Gaussian-PSF calib for the preprint-condition simulations (network set g13): pixel-integrated isotropic Gaussian, sigma 1.3 px (= analysis/baselines/zpsf.GaussPSF(1.3)), opt-in key psf_gauss_sigma_um read by simcode2/psf/vectorial.set_psf_extras; every other block (camera, pattern placeholder, TIRF, z) copied from calib_1809_2_psf3d_avg.json; the vectorial terms are ignored when psf_gauss_sigma_um is set

camera.note: gain 0.56; offset map = loc-masked median - smooth of this movie (masked by baseline smlm.hdf5, frames 0-20000); read noise = 0.5 nM map shifted by the sensor ROI offset (dy 15, dx -6; 83% covered) + high-passed own estimate elsewhere

pattern.steps: frame%6; angle=step//3; I = A*relint*(1+depth*cos(k.r - phase - dphi(t))), r=(x=col,y=row) px
pattern.depth_note: 0.925/0.955: cross-cycle estimator, nn_overlap>=3 subset (real 0.920-0.927 / 0.953-0.954); bench v2 shows this subset within ~+0.02 of truth (worker, 2026-11-08). step_fit regression depth is diluted and must not be written to pattern files.
